en.headline: Your blood pressure, in 30 seconds
body: A heart doctor talks about blood pressure.
High blood pressure often has no signs.
Over years it strains your heart.
Less salt and staying active help.
en.passage: [0:15] High blood pressure often has no symptoms, which is why checking it matters.

ms.headline: Tekanan darah anda, dalam 30 saat
body: Doktor jantung bercakap tentang tekanan darah.
Kurang garam dan kekal aktif membantu.
ms.passage: [0:15] High blood pressure often has no symptoms, which is why checking it matters.

zh.headline: 30秒了解您的血压
body: 一位心脏科医生讲血压。
少吃盐、多活动，都有帮助。
zh.passage: [0:15] High blood pressure often has no symptoms, which is why checking it matters.
